verdict_SUPERSEDED_2026_08_17.cause: The published fit is unweighted nonlinear least squares on F in LINEAR space. Because |F| falls by three orders of magnitude across the window, the single point dr=2 carries 95.8% of the least-squares objective in this dataset (96.0% and 96.3% in the two companion datasets of SIM-2026-015d). The reported exponent is therefore, to within 8%, the dr=2->3 local log-slope (4.2315), not a property of the profile. Changing NOTHING but the error model, and DISCARDING NO DATA, gives alpha = 2.822 (relative-error weighting) or 2.890 (log-space OLS) on the identical dr>=2 window. Independently: dr=2 is the unique separation at which a Hamiltonian bond bridges the two operator supports, i.e. a contact term of exactly the family for which the dr=1 point was already excluded.
verdict_SUPERSEDED_2026_08_17.corrected_result: The local log-slopes of .F_interaction_avg run 2.035, 4.232, 2.603, 2.456, 2.461, 2.533, 2.658, 2.841, 3.102, 3.482, 4.064: a spike at dr=2 and a rise at the far end bracket a genuine intermediate plateau (6 consecutive slopes flat to +/-7.5%) centred on 2.592. CORRECTED MEASUREMENT: alpha = 2.6 +/- 0.2, with the EXCHANGE CHANNEL OPEN -- 2*Delta_T = 4 (stress tensor) is excluded by the plateau, and 2*Delta_epsilon = 2 (scalar) also lies outside the plateau band. See SIM-2026-072 for the full 3 x 5 estimator x window matrix and the bootstrap.
verdict_SUPERSEDED_2026_08_17.raw_data_NOT_in_question: ONLY THE FITS ARE SUPERSEDED. The raw arrays -- .ground_state, .E_singles, .E_duals, .F_interaction_avg, .F_interaction_probe_only, .norms_single, .norms_dual and .force_profile -- are NOT in question, have NOT been altered, and remain the valid record of the measurement. SIM-2026-072 re-analysed exactly these arrays and reproduced the original fit (3.9218 vs 3.9218 recorded) before diverging, which rules out an implementation difference as the cause: the data are sound, the estimator was not.
